schedule_types.input: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset

explicitly_deferred_types.reason: Telemetry-conditioned scheduling belongs to the v0.7 observation and condition engine.
v0.6 authorizes one-shot relative and absolute schedules only.

creation_guards: authenticated C-mode holder has the current active lease and fence
procedure catalog identity and immutable bundle digest resolve
target parses, is within the bounded scheduling horizon, and is not ambiguous
idempotency key is new or resolves to the identical schedule

clock_policy.uncertain_clock: remain PENDING and expose CLOCK_UNCERTAIN; never fire
clock_policy.restart: preserve the original canonical target; never add restart downtime

misfire_policies.rule: After recovery, claim and create the one occurrence if it has not already settled and lateness is within MaximumLateness.
Settle MISSED without an ExecutionId when the target is late under the pinned policy.

occurrence_contract.occurrence_id: stable digest of ScheduleId and TargetAtDatabaseTime
occurrence_contract.claim: single compare-and-set from PENDING to CLAIMED
occurrence_contract.fire: create at most one new ExecutionId in REQUESTED from the pinned catalog, bundle, context, arguments, and Automatic setting
occurrence_contract.outcome: exactly one of FIRED with ExecutionId, CANCELLED, MISSED, or ERROR
occurrence_contract.automatic_rule: Automatic true permits the admitted child to run; false leaves it PAUSED. Schedule settlement itself never bypasses admission.

transitions.result: one durable ScheduleId with its original target and pinned inputs

transitions.guard: database time is at or beyond target, clock is acceptable, and no cancellation won
admission creates or finds the occurrence-bound ExecutionId
authorized C-mode request wins before claim
pinned SKIP policy or MaximumLateness requires skipping
transitions.result: no ExecutionId and original target retained

transitions.guard: deterministic admission failure cannot be retried under the same pinned inputs
transitions.result: no hidden execution and a typed failure

races.loser: returns the winning state without compensating

restart_cases.rule: Reload the same target and remain PENDING.
Apply the pinned misfire policy against the original target.
Find the occurrence-bound execution; create it once only when durable evidence proves none exists.
Settle FIRED with the existing ExecutionId; never create another.
Return the immutable terminal state and original target.
